run-list-query.description: Chronological `runs.list` filters, with explicit ID order for legacy cursors.
run-list-query.title: RunListQuery

RunLogEntry.description: One run log entry: engine entries come from run events, the others from execution logs.
RunLogEntry.title: RunLogEntry

run-log-query.description: `runs.logs` query parameters; `level` is the lowest level returned, `node_id` a static step ID.
run-log-query.title: RunLogQuery

run-step-query.description: `runs.steps` query parameters; `step` is a static step ID and matches every instance.
run-step-query.title: RunStepQuery

RunSummary.description: One `run_summaries.list` item, read from run facts only and never from run payloads.
RunSummary.title: RunSummary

run-summary-query.description: `run_summaries.list` query parameters; the cursor is bound to every filter and the order.
run-summary-query.title: RunSummaryQuery

StepFact.description:
One step instance of a run. With `include=output`, an output that cannot be returned is named in
`omissions` with its reason, and a returned output makes the item a `StepFactWithOutput`.
StepFact.title: StepFact

StepFactWithOutput.description: A step instance whose recorded output passed the RunView classification rules (may be null).
StepFactWithOutput.title: StepFactWithOutput
